summary.en: Taliban forces continue confronting Pakistani security troops along the Kurram border while Pakistan has halted trade at two Iran crossings, affecting the Zangali checkpost and Torkham operations. The United Nations warns Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban-opened road to China faces security hurdles. Pakistan has warned of further action if Afghan soil is used for attacks and a militant overseeing Pakistani Taliban financial operations was killed. Traffic has doubled at the Afghanistan-Iran border after 24‑hour operations began, and a strong earthquake struck the Afghanistan-Pakistan border region. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Taliban-styrker fortsetter å konfrontere pakistanske sikkerhetstroppene langs Kurram-grensen, mens Pakistan har stanset handelen ved to iranske grenseoverganger, noe som påvirker Zangali-kontrollposten og Torkham-operasjonene. FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød, og den Taliban-åpnede veien til Kina møter sikkerhetsutfordringer. Pakistan har varslet ytterligere tiltak dersom afghansk jord brukes til angrep, og en militant som hadde ansvar for Pakistans Taliban-finansoperasjoner ble drept. Trafikken har doblet seg ved Afghanistan-Iran-grensen etter at 24‑timmers operasjoner startet, og et kraftig jordskjelv rammet grenseområdet mellom Afghanistan og Pakistan. 1,794 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
